schema.title: Influence General Link Force/Moment Data Request
schema.description: Request body for one general-link force or moment influence-line data result.

Argument.description: General-link force or moment influence data query arguments.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Optional output file path. Supported extensions are .TXT and .JSON. When omitted, no file is saved. .TXT saves the original MIDAS text layout; .JSON saves the structured JSON result.

UNIT.description: Unit system used for the returned influence data.

FORCE.description: Force unit, such as kN or N.

DIST.description: Distance unit, such as m or mm.

LANE_NAME.description: Selected line or surface lane name.

GENERAL_LINK_NODES.description: I-node and J-node numbers identifying one general link, for example [2475, 2496].

COMPONENTS.description: General-link end position and force or moment component.

COMP.description: One general-link force or moment component.
